In the admin: Enable multishop and create an extra shop so you have at least two. Then put your context on "all shops". Then create a category under "Home". You will see the image of the subcategory is not deleted without this fix.

title: Remove deprecated functions
issue_title: Deprecated in PHP 7.2
issue_body:
Prestashop version: 1.7.4.4
PHP Version: 7.2.12

I got 3 advices in PHP logs:
1.  /controllers/front/CartController.php on line 128 - The each() function is deprecated.
2.  /src/PrestaShopBundle/Controller/Admin/AttributeController.php on line 175 - The each() function is deprecated. + Variable passed to each() is not an array or object
3.  /classes/Mail.php on line 872 - INTL_IDNA_VARIANT_2003 is deprecated

For the third one, It seems now you are supposed to use INTL_IDNA_VARIANT_UTS46 instead. However, PHP seems to be still using INTL_IDNA_VARIANT_2003 as the default if none is specified. So, to avoid this one, you have to explicitly call with INTL_IDNA_VARIANT_UTS46 as parameter.
Something like: 
return $address[0].'@'.idn_to_ascii($address[1],0,INTL_IDNA_VARIANT_UTS46);

PHP docs:
1/2.   http://php.net/manual/en/function.each.php
3.   http://php.net/manual/en/function.idn-to-ascii.php

title: Installer: always clean test assets even if filesystem tests fail, an…
issue_title: Generated test directory at install step is not cleaned if github is down
issue_body:
**Describe the bug**
When a PrestaShop 1.7.5+ is installed, the installer performs several checks to see whether it has been given the proper read&write rights. If these rights are available **and** the PrestaShop Zip archive is not the latest, it offers the user to download the latest Zip archive and install this one.

During these tests, fake files and folders are created. However [one of those tests](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/develop/tools/build/Library/InstallUnpacker/classes/ConfigurationValidator.php#L100) check that PrestaShop is able to download a file from github. If this test fails, the check processing stops there. However the fake files and folders are deleted at the end of the check processing: [here](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/develop/tools/build/Library/InstallUnpacker/classes/ConfigurationValidator.php#L109) and [here](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/develop/tools/build/Library/InstallUnpacker/classes/ConfigurationValidator.php#L113). So if the check fails, the fake files and folders remain in the root folder of PrestaShop. They cause no harm, but they are useless.

This is not critical as this is a bonus feature that does not prevent the installation.

**TO DO**
- make sure fake files and folders are cleaned even if the check processing stops halfway
- do not rely on github to perform the "download" test (find a better test subject)

PrestaShop version: 1.7.5 at least
